tone.target: bright 60s pop-rock clean with subtle tremolo/chorus
tone.profile: bright 60s pop-rock clean with subtle tremolo/chorus
tone.summary: A classic 60s pop-rock setup using a Fender/Vox style clean amp (US Deluxe) combined with subtle overdrive, Chorus, Tremolo, and Spring Reverb to achieve an airy, bright sound.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide a subtle 'edge of breakup' without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate the light grit of vintage single-coil amps (like Fender/Vox) rather than a dedicated boost.

alternatives.reason: Slightly more aggressive, but still suitable for light breakup.

blocks.purpose: Bypass (No dedicated distortion needed for clean tone).
Simulate the bright, clean character of a Fender/Vox style combo amp.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best available model for this classic American clean sound profile.

alternatives.reason: Also suitable, but US Deluxe often captures a slightly brighter pop-rock edge.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound matching the US Deluxe amp.
Add subtle movement and width to the tone (subtle wobble).
blocks.gap: The Chorus is used sparingly to achieve a 'wobble' effect, avoiding thick 80s sounds.

alternatives.reason: If the wobble needs to be purely pitch-based rather than filter/time based.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle pitch variation (tremolo) for vintage pop feel.
blocks.gap: Using Tremolo alongside Chorus allows layering of modulation effects, fulfilling the 'subtle wobble' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Provide a short, airy sense of space without excessive tail.
blocks.gap: While Spring is ideal for 60s pop, Room reverb provides better control over the decay time to keep it 'short' and non-muddy.

alternatives.reason: If a more authentic vintage spring sound is desired, but requires careful mix setting.

blocks.purpose: Brighten the tone and enhance clarity in the upper mids/highs.
blocks.gap: Used to fine-tune the frequency response, emphasizing the 'bright' requirement.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to better capture the bright, airy sound of a 60s pop-rock era single-coil combo.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, airy 60s pop sound and complement the US Deluxe amp model.
